tasks.title: [01] Basketball Game Score
tasks.prompt: Regular field goals are worth 2 points, three-pointers are worth 3 points, and free throws are worth 1 point. Calculate the total score.

tasks.title: [02] Beehive Honey Production
tasks.prompt: Each beehive produces 25 kg of honey per season. Calculate total honey production for a number of beehives.

tasks.title: [03] Bird Migration Distance
tasks.prompt: An Arctic tern covers 71000 km per full round-trip migration. Calculate distance after a number of full migrations.

tasks.title: [04] Paint Color Mixer
tasks.prompt: Red paint costs $12 per liter, blue $15, and yellow $10. Calculate total cost for the requested liters.

tasks.title: [05] Dragon's Treasure Counter
tasks.prompt: One gold coin is 100 silver coins and one silver coin is 100 copper coins. Return total value in copper coins.

tasks.title: [06] Drum Beat Pattern Generator
tasks.prompt: In 4/4 time a kick plays on beats 1 and 3 and a snare on beats 2 and 4. Return kick or snare for a beat from 1 through 4.

tasks.title: [07] Temperature Converter
tasks.prompt: Convert a Celsius temperature to Fahrenheit using F = C × 9/5 + 32.

tasks.title: [08] Rectangle Area
tasks.prompt: Calculate the area of a rectangle from its width and height.

tasks.title: [09] Museum Ticket Total
tasks.prompt: Adult tickets cost $20 and child tickets cost $10. Calculate the total price.

tasks.title: [10] Water Tracker
tasks.prompt: Each glass contains 250 milliliters. Return total milliliters for the number of glasses.

tasks.title: [11] Running Pace
tasks.prompt: Return average speed by dividing distance by time.

tasks.title: [12] Energy Usage
tasks.prompt: Calculate watt-hours by multiplying watts by hours.

tasks.title: [13] Party Portions
tasks.prompt: Each guest receives 3 portions. Return the total portions needed.

tasks.title: [14] Reading Progress
tasks.prompt: Return pages read by multiplying pages per day by days.

tasks.title: [15] Weekly Savings
tasks.prompt: Return total savings by multiplying weekly savings by the number of weeks.

tasks.title: [16] Farm Animal Legs
tasks.prompt: Chickens have 2 legs and cows have 4. Return the total number of legs.

tasks.title: [17] Fuel Needed
tasks.prompt: Return required fuel by dividing distance by fuel efficiency.

tasks.title: [18] Sale Price
tasks.prompt: Apply a percentage discount to a price and return the resulting sale price.

tasks.title: [19] Number Average
tasks.prompt: Return the arithmetic mean of a non-empty array of numbers.

tasks.title: [20] Movie Duration
tasks.prompt: Convert a duration in hours and minutes into total minutes.

tasks.title: [21] Garden Perimeter
tasks.prompt: Return the perimeter of a rectangular garden from its length and width.

tasks.title: [22] Shipping Cost
tasks.prompt: Shipping costs a base fee plus weight multiplied by the per-unit rate.

tasks.title: [23] Even or Odd
tasks.prompt: Return even when the integer is even and odd otherwise.

tasks.title: [24] Circle Circumference
tasks.prompt: Return a circle's circumference using 2 × Math.PI × radius.

tasks.title: [25] Time in Seconds
tasks.prompt: Convert hours, minutes, and seconds into total seconds.
